title: Welcome to Reece
subtitle: Your first day in the forest

quests.title: Welcome to Reece
text: Elder Maren is waiting by Reece's well. She meets every newcomer herself.
Find her in Reece and say hello.

lines: Ah, a new face. Welcome to Reece.
Take this. It's the Field Guide; I wrote half of it, so be kind.
Have a look around before night falls. Reece is small, but it's friendly.

quests.title: Read the Field Guide
text: The Field Guide explains everything the forest has to offer. Lost it? Type /guide for a new one.
Somewhere in it there's a page on the quiet forest. Someone pressed a leaf between its pages and left Reece in a hurry.

quests.title: Old Streets, New Roofs
text: Reece is bigger than it looks. Walk its streets: the smithy, the farms, the chapel and the market square.

lines: The smithy's this way. Mind the anvil.
tasks.title: Say hello at the smithy

lines: Fields don't plant themselves. Nice to meet you.
tasks.title: Say hello at the farms

quests.title: Every Hand Learns
text: Reece trains its people in skills: mining, farming, fishing, fighting and more. Almost everything you do earns skill XP.
Press K to open your skill trees, earn your first point in any tree and spend it.

tasks.checkmark: I spent my first skill point

quests.title: A Bitter Tonic
text: Changed your mind about a skill? Sister Wren, Reece's cleric, brews skill tonics that let you unlearn a tree's choices.
Ask her how they work, and keep one in reserve.

lines: A skill tonic undoes what you've learned in one tree, and gives the points back.
It tastes awful. That's how you know it works.
Keep this one. You'll be glad of it one day.

quests.title: Timber!
text: Every journey starts with a tree. Hold the Ultimine key while you chop and the whole trunk comes down in one go.
Reece's woodpile needs filling: gather 64 oak logs.

quests.title: The Stone That Remembers
text: The waystone in Reece remembers everyone who touches it. Attune to it, then find a second waystone out in the wild.
Waystones let you warp between any you've found.

quests.title: Room to Carry
text: Your pockets won't hold a forest. Stitch a backpack, and fit it with a pickup upgrade so it fills itself as you walk.

quests.title: The Hourglass Night
text: Craft a bed and sleep through your first night. The more of the server is asleep, the faster the stars wheel by.

quests.title: Under the Open Sky
text: Nights on the road are kinder with a sleeping bag, and afternoons are kinder with a hammock.
Make both.

quests.title: The Sexton's Promise
text: Old Edda keeps Reece's graveyard. She has something to tell every newcomer.

lines: Everyone comes to the graveyard eventually. Some sooner than others.
If you fall out there, a gravestone holds your things where you died. Only you can open it.
This belonged to the last adventurer who didn't come back. Read it. Then don't be them.

quests.title: Dressed for Reece
text: Reece's tailor thinks armour is ugly at the harvest dance. You can wear anything over your armour in the cosmetic armour slots of your inventory and keep the protection underneath.
Bring the tailor 8 white wool for a festival outfit.

lines: Armour at a dance? Absolutely not.
Bring me wool and I'll make you something proper.

quests.title: Which Way the Wind Blows
text: A Nature's Compass points to any biome you name. Craft one and use it to find somewhere you've never been.

quests.title: Which Way the Stones Lie
text: An Explorer's Compass points to places people built. Craft one and follow it to the nearest well.

quests.title: Hands of the Field
text: Four organisations work the land and water around Reece. Meet a member of each: the Growers' co-op (farmers), the Anglers' society (fishermen), the Herbalists (clerics) and the Tavern keepers (butchers).
Sneak and right-click a villager to talk.

lines: The co-op's always short of hands. Come and see us.
Fish bite at dawn and dusk. We'll teach you the rest.
Every weed is a medicine to someone.
Nobody leaves a tavern hungry. That's the rule.

quests.title: Hands of the Forge
text: Four more work stone, metal and the hunt: the Miners' guild (toolsmiths), the Crafters' guild (masons), the Bounty office (weaponsmiths, by the bounty board) and the Hunters' lodge (fletchers).

lines: Mind the gravel and carry torches. That's half of mining.
Anything worth making is worth making twice.
The board pays for monsters. Read it every morning.
Walk soft and shoot straight.

quests.title: Hands of the Road
text: And four keep the roads open: the Couriers (cartographers), the Village watch (guards), the Arcane order (librarians) and the Sanctuary keepers (shepherds).

lines: If it needs to be somewhere else, we'll take it.
Keep your eyes open at dusk.
Magic is just knowledge nobody's written down yet.
Every animal deserves somewhere safe.

quests.title: The Cleric's Worry
text: Sister Wren has been watching the forest. She'd like a word.

lines: The forest has gone quiet. No fireflies at dusk, no birdsong.
And the old spirits don't answer my prayers any more.
I don't know what's wrong. Will you help me find out?
